slot_scores.name: demand_satisfaction
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Since total production (250) exceeds total demand (200), must all demand be fully satisfied (i.e., exactly 80 to demand point 1 and 120 to demand point 2), or is it acceptable to ship less than the stated demand at some demand point?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether all demand must be fully satisfied or whether shipping less is acceptable, directly covering the exact demand-satisfaction constraint.

slot_scores.name: minimize_total_cost
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the objective to minimize the total cost (fixed costs plus unit transportation costs), and is there any other objective component such as maximizing shipped quantity or minimizing unmet demand?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether the objective is to minimize total cost including fixed and unit transportation costs, fully covering the hidden objective slot.
